working_definition: Combined T4/T5 subtypes c and d (T4c, T4d, T5c, T5d): directionally selective motion-detecting neurons of the optic lobe, with T4 dendrites in the medulla and T5 dendrites in the lobula and axons to the lobula plate.
searches_performed: T4c neuron / T4d neuron / T5c neuron / T5d neuron
T neuron (common parent, checked in local fbbt.obo release 2026-10-01)

best_match.fbbt_definition: Intrinsic columnar neuron of the optic lobe that has its cell body in the posterior part of the optic lobe and a cell body fiber that bifurcates in the second optic chiasma (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It has two branches, each targeting a different neuropil adjacent to the second optic chiasma (lobula, lobula plate and medulla) (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989).

justification: The group spans T4c, T4d, T5c and T5d. T4 neuron (FBbt:00003731) and T5 neuron (FBbt:00003736) are both is_a T neuron (FBbt:00003726), the most specific common ancestor of all four members; no FBbt term groups subtypes c/d across T4 and T5. Mature terms for pharate-adult and adult stages.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: T4 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 3 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It responds to motion in an upwards direction (Henning et al., 2022).
T4 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 4 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It responds to motion in a downwards direction (Henning et al., 2022).
T5 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 3 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It responds to motion in an upwards direction (Henning et al., 2022).
T5 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 4 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It responds to motion in a downwards direction (Henning et al., 2022).

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00003726 'T neuron' (broad match; members T4c, T4d, T5c, T5d).
